name: goat_describe
summary: Find GOAT capabilities and whether this caller can use them
description: Find GOAT capabilities and how to call them. query takes words or a tool name: exact names first, then paths with every word, then paths sharing some. total, truncated and nextCursor say what else matched; a short result never means nothing else exists. path takes a resource or a path or tool name for its arguments; Example: goat_describe {query:"send a message to a thread"}
guide: Find paths with goat_describe. Pass path, paths or query; limit is 1-50, default 10. Pass nextCursor with the same query and path for the next page.

name: goat_call
summary: Call any GOAT capability by path and get one result shape
description: Call one GOAT capability by path or tool name, with args exactly as that tool takes them; it runs the same checks as a direct call and adds no permission. Returns status ok with value, error with code, reason and retryable, or needs_human with a handoff a person must finish, so do not retry. Example: goat_call {path:"thread.read", args:{threadId:"t1"}}
guide: Find paths with goat_describe. An invalid_request for an argument the path does not take, or one that does not decode, carries details.expectedSignature, the path's arguments on one line.
idempotencyReason: Dispatches through the target tool's own authorization and idempotency admission; args.clientRequestId belongs to that target. Caching the dispatcher would bypass target replay checks and freeze call-again flows.

name: goat_thread_start
description: Delegate a child task; it stays this thread's subagent. Completion wakes this thread; don't poll. A worker cannot start children; a parent may run at most four.

examples.title: Start a review round on another model

args.task: Review the diff on branch fix/flaky-checkout against dev. Report findings with path:line.

guide: Delegate a research lane, review round, or implementation slice from an active agent run in this GOAT thread. The child receives the supplied task prompt without parent conversation history. Prefer mode='async' for long work. timeoutMs in mode='wait' limits the parent's wait and does not cancel the child. Async completion notifies and wakes this thread. Reuse clientRequestId for retries.

parameters.task: The child's whole brief, up to 64 KB.
parameters.title: The child thread's title in the sidebar.
parameters.model: Codex model id; omit to inherit.

name: goat_thread_send
description: Send a message to your child thread, starting or steering a turn.

examples.title: Send a follow-up that a retry cannot duplicate

args.text: Rebase on dev and rerun the failing test.

guide: Use clientRequestId for idempotent retries. The target must be a child of the calling thread.

parameters.threadId: The thread to message. With host, the id that host returned.

name: goat_thread_read
description: Read a child thread's durable state and paginated messages.
guide: Pass before to read a page before a sequence number. Only the calling thread's own children can be read.

parameters.threadId: The thread to read. With host, the id that host returned.

name: goat_thread_list

examples.title: Check on the threads this thread started

guide: Use includeFinished to include finished child threads.

name: goat_thread_wait
description: Wait for a child thread run to end. This only reads state: timeout leaves work running.

examples.title: Wait for a thread’s run to end

guide: Timeout does not interrupt work. Completion wakes this thread; do not poll. Waits are limited to 60000 milliseconds.

parameters.threadId: The thread to wait on. With host, the id that host returned.
parameters.timeoutMs: How long to wait, at most 60000 milliseconds. A timeout leaves the run going.

name: goat_thread_stop
description: Interrupt a child thread’s running turn.
idempotencyReason: Each call stops the current run; a repeat can stop a later run.
guide: The target must be a child of the calling thread.

parameters.threadId: The thread whose turn to interrupt.

name: goat_thread_report_result
description: Record or replace the structured result of this worker thread’s current run for its parent. Recording a result does not end the run.

args.summary: Needs a GitHub token with repo scope to push.

idempotencyReason: A new report replaces the current run’s previous report.
guide: Call once you finish a dispatched task, and call again to replace the report if the result changes. Set outcome to succeeded, failed, blocked when you need something you cannot get, or cancelled. Report only checked facts.

parameters.outcome: succeeded, failed, blocked when you need something you cannot get, or cancelled.

name: goat_send_to_user
description: Send a user notification once per run per kind.
idempotencyReason: The host accepts each kind at most once per run.
guide: Send a notification; the host enforces once per run per kind.

name: goat_ask
description: Create a question, approval, or decision request. A question can carry 1 to 4 questions with 2 to 4 options each, shown on one card. Retry with the same clientRequestId to reuse the result. Silence never approves.

examples.title: Ask whether to merge with a known failing check

args.summary: Merge with the flaky e2e check failing?
args.detail: The same e2e test fails on dev; the change itself passes its own tests.

options.label: Merge now
options.consequence: Lands the fix; dev stays red on that test.

options.label: Wait for the e2e fix
options.consequence: Holds the fix until the test is repaired.

examples.title: Ask the person to choose, two questions on one card

args.summary: How should I fix the failing tests?

questions.question: Which tests should I fix first?
How should I deliver the fix?

guide: A decision requires at least two options; recommended names one of their ids. For choices, ask kind question with questions[{id, header, question, options[{label, description}]}]; put the option you recommend first and end its label with " (Recommended)". End your turn after asking: the person's answer arrives as a new message. The host returns a needs_human handoff.

parameters.summary: The decision, as one short question.
parameters.detail: What the person needs to know to decide.
parameters.options: Choices as {id, label, consequence}; a decision needs at least two.
parameters.questions: 1 to 4 questions shown in turn on one card, each {id, header (12 characters or fewer), question, options: 2 to 4 {label, description}}.
parameters.recommended: decision: the option id you recommend.

name: goat_bot_notes_read
description: From a bot session, read the bot's standing notes: the newest ones, plus older notes that match query.
guide: Your session already started with your newest notes; read again to find older notes about something specific.

parameters.query: Words to match older notes against.

name: goat_bot_notes_change
description: From a bot session, save a note a person's message asked for, or correct an earlier one with replaces. Retry with the same clientRequestId to save it once.
guide: Save a note only when the person asked you to remember or change something; quote their rule in your own words in one line. To correct a note, pass its old text as replaces: the new line replaces it. A saved note reaches your session from its next start.

parameters.note: The note, one line, at most 500 characters.
parameters.replaces: The text of the earlier note this one replaces.
parameters.clientRequestId: Saves the note once across retries.

idempotencyReason: A note saved with a clientRequestId is saved once.
